summary: Add GET /api/alerts/trends?days=N to return UTC daily alert-creation buckets for the last N days with total and per-severity counts, including zero-count days and zero-count severities, while reusing existing severity ordering and query-validation patterns.
constraints: Endpoint route is GET /api/alerts/trends under the existing alerts controller.
days must validate within the inclusive range 1..90.
Non-numeric or out-of-range days values must return 400 with ValidationProblemDetails via the existing query-validation path.
Return one bucket per UTC calendar day for the last N days, oldest first.
Each bucket must include total count and per-severity counts, including zero-count days and zero-count severities.
Severity ordering must match the existing summary endpoint convention: Low, Medium, High, Critical.
Preserve controller -> service -> repository layering and keep persistence logic out of the controller.
coverage_goals: Controller coverage for trend endpoint success-path wiring and validation behavior.
Service coverage for mapping repository aggregates into daily buckets with Low/Medium/High/Critical ordering and zero-filled severity counts.
Repository coverage for UTC day bucketing, oldest-first ordering, last-N-day windowing, and zero-count day filling.
